summary: The open AI model repository ecosystem centers on Hugging Face as the dominant hub, which surpassed 3 million public models by August 2026 and is adding over a million models per year, though downloads are heavily concentrated among a tiny fraction of top models. Alongside the hub model, a growing layer of developer-facing inference platforms—Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, and others—provide easy local or API-based access to open-weight models without the overhead of self-managed infrastructure. These platforms differ from enterprise aggregators and MLOps suites by focusing on open models, serverless inference, and developer accessibility.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The largest open repository and collaboration hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints for deploying and running models.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, adding ~1M+ per year)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and limited inference; PRO at ~$9/mo; Spaces and Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise plans available
features: Massive model, dataset, and Spaces catalog
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Hosted Inference Endpoints and Serverless Inference API
Model cards, versioning, and Git-based repos
Download stats and community collaboration tools
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaborative tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool for running open-weight LLMs on personal machines and servers with a simple CLI and API, bundling model weights and configuration.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi, and variants/quantizations)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source (run locally); optional Ollama cloud/hosted offerings billed by usage
features: One-command local model download and run
GGUF quantized models for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want to run open models locally for privacy, prototyping, or offline use

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open-source models via API, including custom models packaged with Cog, with pay-per-use serverless inference.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (LLMs, image, video, audio, and multimodal)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU pricing); no monthly minimum
features: Run any model via a simple REST API
Cog packaging for custom model deployment
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to ship AI features (especially generative media) fast without managing GPU infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference and fine-tuning cloud offering fast, scalable API access to a wide range of open-source LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference; per-GPU-hour for dedicated endpoints; fine-tuning billed separately
features: Broad open-model catalog including latest releases
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers building production LLM apps on open models who need speed, scale, and fine-tuning

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform optimized for low-latency, cost-efficient serving of open-source LLMs and multimodal models in production.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; per-GPU-hour for on-demand dedicated deployments; fine-tuning available
features: Optimized inference engine (FireAttention) for low latency
Function calling and structured JSON output
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
platforms.best_for: Teams needing fast, production-grade, cost-efficient inference for open LLMs at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong in the Chinese and Asian markets) providing API access to open-source LLMs, image, and audio models with competitive pricing.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, FLUX, and other popular Chinese and global open models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage-based; generous free tier and low-cost access to many open models
features: Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models
Popular amid rising Chinese open-model adoption
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking affordable API access to leading Chinese and global open models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open-source LLMs at very high token throughput via API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference with aggressive pricing; free developer tier available
features: Custom LPU hardware for extreme speed
Focus on popular open chat models
platforms.best_for: Developers who need the fastest possible real-time inference for open LLMs

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many model providers (open and proprietary), letting developers access hundreds of models through one endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with a small routing margin; credits-based
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access and easy switching between open and closed models
